local_review.finding_body: The JDK 25 current-defaults, latest-EA current-defaults, and latest-EA future-defaults-all jobs all failed in LibrealsenseTest.loadsMatchingNativeApiAndReportsNoConnectedDevices() when context construction returned libusb_init(...) returned LIBUSB_ERROR_OTHER. A required test must exercise meaningful public API behavior consistently on the JVM and under Native Image rather than depend on host USB initialization. §FS-test-contract.1.3 §FS-test-contract.4
local_review.finding_title: Hardware-dependent USB context test fails on USB-less CI hosts
local_review.fix_note: Changed the test to verify the compile-time and loaded native API versions without initializing USB hardware, kept the separate incompatible-version error-path coverage, made librealsense-platform use the resolved libraryVersion instead of a pinned version, and regenerated stats. Verified with ./gradlew clean test on JDK 25 current-defaults and latest-EA current-defaults, GVM_TCK_NATIVE_IMAGE_MODE=future-defaults-all ./gradlew clean test on latest EA, plus checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, spotlessCheck, validateIndexFiles, generateLibraryStats, and validateLibraryStats.
local_review.review_comment: All three required metadata-test jobs failed in both JVM and Native Image execution because LibrealsenseTest initialized a physical USB context and CI returned LIBUSB_ERROR_OTHER. I replaced that host-dependent scenario with deterministic native API compatibility coverage, removed the hardcoded platform dependency version, refreshed the library stats, and reviewed the complete single-coordinate diff. Current-defaults passed with both the JDK 25 and latest-EA GraalVM installations, future-defaults-all passed with latest EA, and metadata, index, style, formatting, and stats validation passed. The repaired tree is ready.
